messages:
rachel: Quick brief 1: propose tightening on-prem priv-deploy for keystore: remove clusterrole binding, introduce namespace-scoped roles, and lock egress to HSM CIDRs.

  todd: OK. Need exact permissions and rollback plan. Also: ensure audit traceability for KMS ops.

  rachel: Role matrix: `keystore-reader` (get,list,watch secrets,pods); `keystore-rotator` (update secrets/keystore-certs only); RoleBinding to serviceAccount `keystore-agent`. No ClusterRole.

  anvi: Audit: k8s audit webhook will tag each entry with `x-rw-request-id` header (sha256) and we already log KMS request ids. We'll correlate on that id. Also keep the apiserver audit-policy to log requests for secrets.

  ops-bot: [automated] Preflight suggestion: run `kubectl auth reconcile --manifest=keystore-roles.yaml --dry-run=server` and `netpol-checker --namespace=keystore --simulate`.

  todd: NetPol: deny all ingress, egress allowlist to HSM CIDRs + controlplane monitoring. Provide explicit ports (e.g., TCP 1696 for PKCS#11, 53 for DNS, 123 for NTP). No control-plane egress.

  rachel: Draft netpol snippet included in runbook. We'll add CNI hostNetwork exceptions for kubelet health probes.

  anvi: Vulnerability triage: scanner found outdated libssl in current image. We'll stage RBAC+NetPol first, then image patch separately. Keep canary at 5% for 1hr and watch `keystore_agent_errors_total`.

  todd: Incident steps if agents 403: 1) Prom alert `keystore_agent_errors_total{code=\"403\"}` fires, 2) run `kubectl auth can-i --as=system:serviceaccount:keystore:agent get secrets/keystore-certs`, 3) fetch apiserver audit for SA and crosslink KMS request id, 4) if misconfig revert RoleBinding. Open channel #priv-deploy-ops.

  compliance: Must have ephemeral elevated access for SREs: issue OIDC short-lived tokens (30m) via portal with mandatory session recording and automatic revocation. No static breakglass keys.

  rachel: Adding a smoke script to runbook for preflight and post-deploy checks (auth-can-i, curl HSM ping, verify audit entry). Example:

  ```bash
  kubectl --namespace=keystore run --rm -i --restart=Never smoke --image=alpine -- sh -c '\n    kubectl auth can-i get secrets/keystore-certs --as=system:serviceaccount:keystore:agent && \\n    nc -zv hsm.example 1696
  '
  ```

  ops-bot: [automated] Runbook created: https://confluence.internal/redwood/keystore-isolation-egress-auditflow. Includes manifest links, rollback steps, and smoke commands.

  anvi: Also add Prom rule: `alert: KeystoreAuthFailures` expr: `increase(keystore_agent_errors_total{code=\"403\"}[5m]) > 0` with runbook link. Add Grafana panel for KMS latency p50/p95.

  todd: Schedule: staging rollout 2:00 UTC canary 5% 1h. If green, promote. If misconfig revert immediately.

  rachel: I'll open PR with Role + RoleBinding manifests, NetPol, Prom rule, and runbook. Tagging @todd @anvi for review. :lock:
